name: Allée du Quotidien — étape 17 · se doucher, alarmer, s'abstenir
note: Tiered verb place. -er LEFT (duchess in a shower cap under the garden shower with her wall mirror, man leaping from a giant ringing alarm clock, woman shelling green peas on the balcony, jockey rippling a bedsheet at the upper window, outraged man whose cake a seagull steals on the roof terrace), -ir/-re RIGHT (strongman refusing the baker's cream cake, mirror on the wall). Forward = far lane; back = near cobbles.
